external_id.description: The backup ID in Cinder service

parent_id.description: ONLY FOR NOVA: ID of the VM resource in the volume(s)

planParameters.description: DEPRECATED. Left to support types for old Karbor versions in the private cloud

planStatusObject.description: Status of the plan. `running` — the plan is active; `suspended` — the plan is stopped; `deleted` — the plan is deleted

full_day.description:
- `NULL` — full backups plan.
- `0-6` — incremental backups plan, the number represents the full backup day of the week.

max_backups.description: Max backups amount stored in the plan

pattern.description: Pattern represents the cron rule for a backup. Note: for a DB or a DB cluster, if they have a time period of less than 1 day, only 3, 6, and 12 periods of time are available

project_id.description: ID of the project. You can find it in your VK Cloud management console in the project settings, **Terraform** tab

triggerObject.description: The object by default is created only in automatic backup plans

triggerProperties.description: Different properties of the trigger. See the `triggerProperties` object description for more info

pattern.description: Pattern represents the cron rule for a backup. Note: for a DB or a DB cluster, if they have a time period of less than 1 day, only 3, 6, and 12 hour periods of time are available

max_backups.description: Max backups amount stored in the plan

next_time.description: Shows the time when the next backup will be created

gfsRequest.description: `gfsRequest` object in JSON format while using GFS retention policy

grandfather.description: How many yearly backups to keep

father.description: How many monthly backups to keep

son.description: How many daily backups to keep

grandfather.description: How many yearly backups to keep

father.description: How many monthly backups to keep

son.description: How many daily backups to keep

in_progress.description: How many entities are in progress

is_old_backup.description: Is it shared by several checkpoints

size.description: Size of the checkpoint. Represents the sum of its resource sizes (the maximum capacity of each is counted)

resource_size.description: Size of the backup. Represents the sum of its backup sizes (used space of each is counted)

timestamp.description: When the checkpoint was created in Unix Timestamp (service field)

created_at.description: When the checkpoint was created in ISO 8601 standard

done_at.description: When the checkpoint was completed in ISO 8601 standard

link_id.description: NULL if the backup is full, UUID if the backup is incremental

external_ids.description: IDs of the external resources. By default, a VM has 2 external IDs: the Nova instance and its boot drive in Cinder. A DB and a DB cluster have only 1 external ID

service.description: The name of the external service that returned an error while creating the checkpoint

checkpoint_id.description: ID of the checkpoint related to the restore

parameters.description: Parameters necessary for `restoreObject` to be restored

resources_reason.description: Reasons for the erroneous resources that could not be restored

nics.description: Should include network_id and/or subnet_id or subnet_id/subnet-id or port_id as JSON

links.description: Links to the resources in question.

counts.description: The number of plans in the project at the time of the request

size.description: The total size of the backups in the project at the time of the request

last_time.description: When the last checkpoint was created in Unix Timestamp
